description.name: Client Services & Expiry Monitor
description.tagline: Real-time client active services & domains monitoring sorted by next due date with WhatsApp & Call connect
description.long: A modern, real-time WHMCS addon module to monitor all active client products, services, and domains sorted by next due date with client phone number, one-click WhatsApp chat, and direct phone call connect.
features: Live real-time product & service monitoring without page reloads
Automatic sorting by next due date (expiring soonest on top)
Displays client phone number with 1-click WhatsApp & Call buttons
Multi-type filtering: VPS/Servers, Shared, Reseller, and Domains
Quick expiry filters (Due Today, 3 Days, 7 Days, Overdue)
Instant debounced search across clients, phones, domains, and IPs
